whenToUse: Small whole numbers, such as a cart quantity or the number of people.
Values most people change only once or twice.
Values with a fixed minimum and maximum.
whenNotToUse: Numbers with a wide range, such as amounts or heights: type them in a text field.
Choosing a rough value (use a slider).

alternatives.name: Segmented Control
alternatives.reason: Choosing one of a few options.

accessibility: The middle box has role="spinbutton" and announces aria-valuenow, valuemin, and valuemax.
The up and down arrows change it one step at a time, and a typed value is clamped to the range when focus leaves.
Button names say what changes, such as "Decrease quantity" and "Increase quantity".
At the maximum, the button turns off and the reason is written out ("You can buy up to 5").
